title: The AI Tool That Just Killed Web Developers #shorts  #ai #technology #aitutorial #chatgpt
description:
Are you tired of paying a full production team, developers, motion designers, and Blender artists for cinematic 3D websites? In this video, I reveal a new AI tool called Omma that lets you build amazing, interactive 3D websites using just one prompt.

Omma makes building these websites feel as easy as using Canva. You can even collaborate with your team in real time directly from your browser. People are already using it for AI product showcases, gaming-style websites, and viral brand visuals that look insanely expensive. Previously, you needed an entire production team to create these, but now one creator with the right vision can do it alone.

If you are using tools like Omma, you are literally ahead of 90 percent of the internet.
